ext_description.message: Select a word or sentence on any page and send it to the Flashcard app's inbox.

command_add_selection.message: Add the selected text to Flashcard

offline_intro.message: The Flashcard app is not reachable. Open the app and turn on Local API in Settings → Modules.

pair_intro.message: Connect the extension to the app once. The app will ask you to approve it.

pair_waiting.message: Waiting for approval in the Flashcard app…

pair_revoked.message: The app no longer accepts this extension. Connect again.

pair_rate_limited.message: Too many connection requests. Wait a minute and try again.

field_back_hint.message: Optional: fill it in later in the inbox

cached_note.message: The app is closed: showing the last known decks. The item will be sent when the app opens.

queued_offline.message: The app is closed. Saved; it will be sent when the app opens.

queued_unpaired.message: Saved. Connect the extension again to send it.

queued_busy.message: The app is busy or the inbox is turned off. Saved; it will be sent later.

queue_full.message: Too many items are waiting. Open the app to send them first.

error_validation.message: The app did not accept this item. Check the fields.

error_not_found.message: Something it refers to no longer exists in the app.

error_not_found_deck.message: That deck no longer exists. Pick another one.

error_conflict.message: The app could not take the item right now.

error_conflict_module_disabled.message: The inbox is turned off in the app (Settings → Modules).

error_permission.message: The extension is not allowed to do this. Check its permissions in the app.

error_other.message: Something went wrong in the app.

options_port_hint.message: Same as Settings → Local API → Port in the app. Only 127.0.0.1 is used.

options_conn_offline.message: The app is not reachable on this port.

options_unpaired.message: Not connected. Open the popup to connect.

options_discard_confirm.message: Discard the rejected items? This cannot be undone.
